title: 15 Businesses AI Can't Replace
description:
AI can write, draw and code, but it can't fix a pipe or care for your parents. Here are 15 businesses AI can't replace, how they make money, and how owners use AI to make them more profitable.

Get The Ryan Rover Money Playbook: [LINK HERE]

9:51 6. Personal training and fitness studios
11:16 7. Hair, nails and beauty
12:46 8. Tattoo studios

26:17 Four mistakes owners make with AI
27:04 Angle 1: The numbers
29:50 Angle 2: The psychology
31:48 Angle 3: The playbook
32:50 Questions people ask
34:52 Recap
35:57 What to do next

Sources:
- Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Outlook Handbook (employment projections for trades, care and personal services)
- U.S. Census Bureau, population projections (growth of the 65 and older population)
- U.S. Small Business Administration, small business data
- AI profit example: simplified illustration ($1M revenue, 10% margin, $30,000 cost savings, about $20,000 added profit)
